notes:
Overview: Radial Arc Knowledge builds an enterprise search product for law firms and corporate legal teams. They index contracts, pleadings, and regulatory docs (~15M documents, ~120TB raw). Primary goal: improve legal clause retrieval quality while keeping cost per query low and latency acceptable for interactive workflows.

Key stakeholders: CTO (Marta Ivey) - product lead for search; Head of AI (Dr. Samuel Osei) - owns embedding + reranker stack; Procurement legal team (Emily Chan) managing contracts and data residency.

Requirements summary:
- Workload: two-stage RAG: vector retrieval (embedding nearest-neighbor) + cross-encoder reranker for top-50 results.
- Indexing scale: ~15M documents, expect quarterly ingest bursts.
- Latency targets: p50 <= 120-150ms for retrieval path, p95 <= 450ms end-to-end (retrieval + rerank) for interactive UI.
- Throughput target: sustained 100-150 qps during business hours; spikier peaks to 400 qps for eDiscovery runs.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost/query $0.01 - $0.04 (exclude storage), want guidance to trade cost vs quality.
- Model preferences: open models preferred where possible; willing to pilot quantized variants. Must support cross-encoder reranker variants for quality.
- Security/compliance: strict EU data residency for subsets, SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs for all requests.

Current stack: local vector DB (self-hosted Elastic + custom ANN), embedding: SBERT-derived 768-d vectors (current baseline), reranker: lightweight cross-scorer (TF-IDF + LightGBM rerank features). They report accuracy gaps on clause-level retrieval vs. human labels.

POC / Eval plan discussed with Redwood:
- Phase 0 (offline): run 10k query offline eval across existing ground truth set (contract clause relevance). Metrics: MRR@10, Recall@50, failure-rate by clause-type, per-query cost.
- Phase 1 (A/B offline embed swap): Replace embedding encoder with Redwood-recommended model(s) and compute embeddings for same corpus; run batch ANN comparisons and rerank with held-out cross-encoder to estimate delta.
- Phase 2 (small live canary): 2-week canary using dedicated capacity for a subset of customers (5% traffic) with canary metrics collection and automated rollback on quality regression >3% MRR drop.
- Phase 3 (gradual rollout): staged rollout with A/B and canary toggles, policy-based fallback to previous model if latency or quality thresholds breached.

Discussion notes / quotes: 
- "If we get a 1.5-2x improvement on clause precision without >2x cost increase we'll seriously consider migration." — Dr. Osei.
- "We cannot accept regressions in core clause-retrieval; legal teams will notice quickly." — Marta Ivey.
- Security team: "Need full data residency proof and KMS key lifecycle management details."

Technical risks / open questions:
- Quality regression tolerance not fully agreed (business wants zero regressions on critical clause types).
- ANN index rebuild time for 15M docs - need snapshot + incremental indexing plan.
- Cross-encoder reranker compute cost for top-50 rerank at 150 qps — cost estimate requested.
- Latency SLOs vs batching: Redwood Optimize recommendations helpful but must ensure interactive latency retained.

Recent activity timeline:
- 2024-07-02: Lead created (intro form + initial fit score).
- 2024-07-09: Discovery call (Jordan K, Marta I) — covered scale and security needs.
- 2024-07-22: Technical deep-dive w/ SE (Rhett) — shared dataset stats and baseline evals.
- 2024-08-13: Security sync (fireflies ff_20240813_3245) — Radial Arc sent security questionnaire.
- 2024-08-28: POC kickoff — Redwood provided baseline embed configs and evaluation harness.
- 2024-09-04: Offline eval results delivered (ff_20240904_1187) — preliminary embedding candidates outperform baseline on MRR@10 but mixed on recall for rare clause types.
- 2024-09-10: Commercial touchpoint — procurement requested draft SOW and pricing for dedicated pool + private VPC option.

POC success criteria (draft):
- MRR@10 improvement >= 6% on production query distribution OR Recall@50 increase >= 8% for critical clause types.
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 450ms during canary.
- Cost delta <= 1.8x vs current per-query cost for live traffic, or clear optimization plan (quantization, batching) that meets cost target within 90 days.

Next steps (short):
- Align on final success criteria (Jordan/Rhett to own).
- Provide test VPC credentials and sample ingest pipeline for Redwood (Radial Arc security will provision).
- Redwood to deliver detailed cost model for reranker at scale + quantization options (due 2024-09-20).
- Schedule evals workshop with product + data team (target week of 2024-09-22).

Blockers (summary): procurement SLA review, EU residency proof, and need for stronger offline eval coverage across rare clause types.

Notes on selling approach: aim for Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable reranker throughput + Optimize package for quantization recommendations. Private (VPC) ask likely required for procurement sign-off. Keep hosted API as fallback for early canary where VPC not yet provisioned.
notes_short: Enterprise legal search. 15M docs. Evaluation-focused POC for embedding + reranker migration. Offline evals -> live canary -> staged rollout. Key asks: quality regression guardrails, EU residency, SSO/KMS, cost model for reranker at scale.
